values: 2200014 / AMR-021-0014 and 2200015 / AMR-021-0015: Forsgård–Shapiro weighted Conjecture 9 and unweighted Conjecture 10, Shapiro arXiv:1503.05295v1 p.4; https://arxiv.org/abs/1503.05295v1

Prior full disproofs credited to Olga Katkova, Boris Shapiro and Anna Vishnyakova, In search of Newton-type inequalities, JMAA 538(1) (2024), article 128349, Section 5 Conjectures 2–3; one publication row covers both original targets. Weighted Conjecture 9 selects strictly positive (k+1)ak²−k a(k−1)a(k+1); unweighted Conjecture 10 selects all nonnegative ak²−a(k−1)a(k+1), including zeros, with zero-extended endpoints and increasing-index consecutive parity changes. Credited explicit reconstructions have 22 distinct simple negative roots versus parity count 20 in degree 24 (D=10^6), and 13 versus 11 in degree 15 (D=10^7), refuting both distinct and multiplicity conventions. Fresh original and KSV arXiv v1 essential proofs inspected; the v1 finite-product endpoint shift is independently corrected by the based-primitive recurrence, with unchanged limits. Journal DOI identity authenticated; publisher mathematical body inaccessible and not claimed read or corrected. Same-paper arXiv aliases are not additional solutions. Later Ferudun alternative notes DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23056319 and 10.5281/zenodo.23056466 currently credit KSV (2024); their alternative proofs and full packages remain unadjudicated here. These are existing journal results, not new project disproofs, new DOI uploads, certified firstness, minimal-degree claims or human-refereed reconstructions. This joint independent review is AI-only and unrefereed; exact normal/-O/-OO checks supplement complete symbolic proofs.
